coverage: Complete128conditions,64systems,8rawdraws,12futureframes,80ps.No conditions/draws excluded. Candidate and reference condition/system identities match;all per-condition MD observables agree within1e-10.
definition: Existing last-observed protein reference alignment. For consecutive ligand shapes, fit a proper rotation with fixed atom identities and separately measure centroid translation, rotation-fit displacement and remaining shape change. Includes observed-to-first-future step. Diagnostic fitting never modifies saved forecasts or primary geometry/motion scores.
paired_error_definition: For each system, first average its two condition amplitudes; compute abs(B-MD)-abs(reference-MD), then existing system_estimate on paired system differences. Descriptive absolute amplitude error, not a proper distribution score. Bootstrap CI is on differences,not subtraction of marginal endpoints.
old16_retained: B improves total/translation/internal amplitude errors versus h/v;rotation difference unresolved.Versus PVB,translation/rotation errors improve,internal residual worsens,total unresolved.Full estimates and all condition rows remain in source outputs.
judgment: B improves overall translation and rotation amplitude matching while reducing,but not resolving,the old h/v excess internal-shape motion. New48 internal residual remains about1.89times MD and1.84times PVB. These coexist with worse B bond geometry than PVB and poor rollout chemistry. Do not dismiss favorable collective-motion evidence or call all movement random;do not infer state-only causality. Increasing global amplitude is not supported as a remedy for excess internal deformation.
next: Complete paired A/second-seed/static panels and current bounded temporal-order contrast. Its success must preserve collective movement while reducing internal distortion,not only improve temporal correlation. No extra source/loss/rigid-body constraints added from this diagnosis alone.
limitations: Internal residual includes legitimate torsions/deformations,not exclusively bond jitter
Rotation/internal squared norms have a nonzero cross term;not additive energy fractions
Translation uses ligand centroid,not mass-weighted center of mass
Fixed atom identities,no ligand symmetry remapping;near-collinear rotations can be ambiguous
One MD future per condition;finite-window amplitude agreement is not equilibrium,thermodynamic or kinetic correctness
Exploratory marginal system-bootstrap intervals,unmatched native histories/training/resources,and development-set reuse
One B training seed;no proof that coordinate state alone causes improvement
